23:6: - siwa ar tlawin nnsen, neɣ taklatin nnsen. Akka, ur degsen tiyta;
23:7: wid ibɣan sennig waya, widak zegren tilisa -,
23:8: wid iţqadaren lamanat nnsen, u lemɛahda nnsen;
23:11: wid ara iweṛten Loennet, degs ad wekkṛen.
23:12: Niɣ Nexleq amdan, seg ufṣil n talaxt,
23:13: sinna, Nerra t d tiqqit deg umekkan n laman;
23:14: sinna, tiqqit Nxelq iţ d argen; dɣa, argen Nxelq it d acelleqluq; dɣa, acelleqluq Nxelq it d iɣsan; dɣa, Nessels aksum i yiɣsan. Sinna, Nxelq it d lxelq amaynut. Ad Ibarek Ṛebbi, Imxeyyeṛ ixellaqen!
23:15: Sinna, deffir waya, war ccekk, a ţţemmtem.
23:16: Sinna, ih, ass n tnekra, a d tuɣalem.
23:17: Niɣ Nexleq, sennig wen, ṣa iberdan. Ur Nelli, ɣef uxlaq, seg iɣwefliyen.
23:18: Nessader ed, seg igenni, aman s lmizan. Naɛteq iten di tmurt. Nezmer a ten Nessṛuḥ.
23:19: Nxelq awen, yissen, leonanat n tezdayin akked tẓuṛin; degsen, i kunwi, aṭas n yizwayen, teţţeţţem segsen;
23:20: Akked ttejṛa, id iffɣen seg udrar n Sina. Teţţak ed zzit u ddhin, i wid iteţţen.
23:21: Ih, di lmal, aselmed i kunwi. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg iɛabbaḍ nnsen. Aṭas n ubaɣuṛ degsen, i kunwi. Teţţeţţem segsen.
23:23: Niɣ Nuzen ed Nuḥ i ugdud is. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ɛabdet Ṛebbi. Ur awen illi ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Day ur teţḥezziben ara"?
23:24: Nnan imḍebbṛen ijehliyen, n ugdud is: "wagi d amdan kan, am kunwi; ibɣa a d ikk sennig wen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, a d Issers lmalayek. Ur nesli s waya, ar lejdud nneɣ imezwura.
23:25: Neţţa d argaz kan aṛehbani. Qaṛaɛet eţ, tallit kan".
23:26: Inna: "a Mass iw! Awes iyi, skaddben iyi".
23:27: Nweḥḥa yas d: "eṣnaɛ lbabuṛ, ger wallen nneɣ, s uweḥḥi nneɣ. Mi d iusa lameṛ nneɣ, la ţfeggiḍen igwefran, d ihedman, awi degs, tayuga n yal ṣṣenf, akked twacult ik, siwa wid, segsen, iɣef id izwar wawal. Ur iyI d steqsay af wid idensen, nitni, war ccekk, ad ţwaɣeḍsen.
23:28: Mi tɛannceḍ di lbabur, kečč akked wid illan yidek, ini: ccekṛan i Ṛebbi i ɣ Iselken seg ugdud imednas".
23:29: Ini: "a Mass iw! Ssers iyi deg umekkan iṛqan; Kečč Tifeḍ akw wid issrusun".
23:30: War ccekk, ayagi, d issekniyen, u Nekwni, Nezga d wid iţjeṛṛiben.
23:31: Sinna, Nxelq ed, deffir sen, isuta nniḍen.
23:32: Nuzen asen d amazan, segsen: "ɛabdet Ṛebbi, ur tesɛim ṛebbi, war Neţţa. Day ur teţḥezzibem ara"?
23:33: Nnan imḍebbṛen ijehliyen n ugdud is, wid iugin u inekṛen timlilit n laxeṛt, wid Neɣna di tmeddurt n ddunit: "wagi d amdan kan am kunwi, iteţţ seg wayen teţţeţţem, itess seg wayen teţţessem.
23:34: Ma tessemḥessem i umdan i kwen icban, war ccekk, kunwi seg imexsuṛen.
23:35: Day i wen iɛahed ard a d teffɣem mara temmtem, tuɣalem d akal, d iɣsan?
23:37: I illan kan, d tameddurt n ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir, nekwni ur d neţţenkar.
23:38: Neţţa, d argaz kan id igren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi. Nekwni, ur numin yis".
23:39: Inna: "a Mass iw! Awes iyi, skaddben iyi".
23:40: Inna: "garaneɣ d cwiṭ, a d gwrin di nndama".
23:41: Iwwet iten usuɣu, s tideţ. Nerra ten d rrmim. Err akin, agdud imednas!
23:42: Sinna, Nxelq ed, deffir sen, isuta nniḍen.
23:43: Lois ur d isseqṛab, ur iswexxiṛ, lajel is.
23:44: Sinna, Nuzen ed imazanen nneɣ, wa deffir wa. Yal tikelt ideg ara d ias umazan, ar lois is, a t skiddben. Nerra ten mestebɛan, Nerra ten d tidyanin. Err akin, agdud ur neţţamen!
23:45: Sinna, Nuzen ed Musa akked gma s Haṛun, s issekniyen nneɣ, akked udabu n ṣṣeḥ,
23:46: ɣeṛ Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Smeɣwṛen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud amzuxxi.
23:47: Nnan: "Day a namen sin imdanen am nekwni, u agdud nnsen d aklan nneɣ"?
23:48: Skaddben ten, dɣa uɣalen seg wid iţwanɣan.
23:49: Niɣ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, amar ad ţwanhun.
23:50: Nerra mmi s n Meryem, akked imma s, d assekni. Nesduri ten di tiɣilt, degs laman d waman.
23:51: A yimazanen, eččet seg wayen imaɛnen, xedmet ayen ilhan, Nek, Ẓṛiɣ ayen txeddmem.
23:52: Lois agi nnwen, s tideţ, d lois yiwen. Nek, d Mass nnwen, ihi ḥezbet iyI.
23:53: Bḍan lameṛ nnsen garasen, mi mfaṛaqen. Yal akabar ifṛeḥ s wayla s.
23:54: Eoo iten di maylellif nnsen, tallit kan.
23:55: Day ɣilen mi sen Nefka ayla, tarwa,
23:56: ad asen Nezzazal lxiṛ? Xaṭi, ur faqen.
23:57: Ih, wid, si tugwdi n Mass nnsen, ţḥadaren,
23:58: wid iumnen s issekniyen n Mass nnsen,
23:60: wid iţţaken ayen fkan, ulawen nnsen ugaden mi, nitni, ad uɣalen ar Mass nnsen,
23:61: widak, ţḥirin ar lxiṛ u, ɣuṛes, zeggwiren.
23:62: Ur Neţkellif taṛwiḥt, siwa ar wayen iwumi tezmer. ɣuṛneɣ Tazmamt, tessawal tideţ. Nitni ur twadensen.
23:63: Maca, ulawen nnsen di maylellif, ɣef tagi. U rnan yir igiten i waya, a ten xedmen.
23:64: Alamma, mi Nesɛadda aɛaqeb ɣef isɛayen nnsen, a d suɣen.
23:65: "Ur ţsuɣut, ass agi, kunwi, segneɣ, ur teţwasellkem.
23:66: Niɣ mlan awen issekniyen iW, trewlem asen,
23:68: Day ur meyyzen ara Awal? Day ur ten id iusa ara, wayen ur d nusi ar lejdud nnsen imezwura?
23:69: Neɣ day ur ssinen ara amazan nnsen, imi t nekṛen?
23:70: Neɣ qqaṛen: "ikcem it loenn"? Xaṭi, iusa ten id s tideţ. Tegwti degsen, kerhen tideţ.
23:71: Lemmer tedda tideţ d lhawiyyat nnsen, war ccekk, tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen, ad fesden. Xaṭi, Nebbwi yasen d asmekti nnsen. Nitni asmekti nnsen ooan t.
23:72: Neɣ, ad asen tessutreḍ taqdiɛt? Pţif taqdiɛt n Mass ik. Neţţa Yif akw iṛeẓẓaqen.
23:73: Kečč, s tideţ, la ten tneccdeḍ s abrid uwqim.
23:74: Wid ur numin ara s laxeṛt, s tideţ, ffɣen i ubrid.
23:75: Xas Nḥun fellasen, u Nekkes asen ccqa nnsen, ad ḍellelen di leqheṛ nnsen, ad ddebdeben.
23:76: Niɣ Nesɛadda fellasen aɛaqeb. Ur knan i Mass nnsen, ur nujen.
23:77: Armi, mara asen Nelli tabburt uɛaqeb iqesḥen, imiren, degs, ad aysen.
23:78: Neţţa i wen Ixelqen timesliwt, iẓṛi, ulawen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
23:79: Neţţa ikwen Iwezzɛen di tmurt. ɣuṛeS ara teţwafesrem.
23:80: Neţţa i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. IneS afraz n yiḍ akked wass. Day ur tefhimem ara?
23:82: Nnan: "Ma nemmut, nuɣal d akal, d iɣsan, day a ɣ d ssekren?
23:83: Niɣ iţţuɛahed wayagi i nekwni, akw, zik, i imezwura nneɣ. Ayagi, siwa d timucuha imezwura".
23:84: Ini: "wi ţ ilan tmurt, akked wayen illan degs, ma tessnem"?
23:85: A d inin: "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur d tesmektayem ara"?
23:86: Ini: "anwa ay d Mass n ṣa igenwan? Mass n usgeld ameqwṛaḥan"?
23:87: A d inin: "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur teţḥezzibem ara"?
23:88: Ini: "anwa i Isɛan tagelda n yal cci, ger ifassen iS; Neţţa Iţḥarab, ur illi uḥareb fellaS, ma teţţissinem"?
23:89: A d inin: "d Ṛebbi". Ini: "ihi, acimi teţwamelkem"?
23:90: Xaṭi! Nefka yasen tideţ, nitni, war ccek, d ikeddaben.
23:91: Ur Isɛi Ṛebbi mmi S. Ur illi ṛebbi ar tama S. Mulac yal ṛebbi ad iawi ayen id ixleq, wa ad iagwar wa. Gedha s Ṛebbi, seg wayen id snulfuyen!
23:92: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. D Aɛlayan, sennig wayen ţcaraken.
23:93: Ini: "a Mass iw! Lemmer a yi d Tessekneḍ acu i sen iţţuɛahden.
23:94: A Mass iw, ur iyi Pţara deg ugdud imednas".
23:95: "S tideţ, Nezmer ad ak Nessken acu i sen Nɛahed".
23:96: Err akin tucmiţ s lfayeq. Nekwni Neẓṛa, sennig wiyaḍ, ayen d snulfuyen.
23:97: Ini: "a Mass iw! Ḥerz iyi seg uɣwayen n ccwaṭen. Ḥḥ
23:98: Ḥerz iyi, a Mass iw! Ur dgi ţţilin".
23:99: Armi, mi d tusa tmeţţant yiwen degsen, inna: "a Mass iw! Err iyi,
23:100: amar ad xedmeɣ ayen ilhan deg wayen ooiɣ". Xaṭi, d awal kan id inna. Tella, deffir es, tseɣlit, alamma d ass n tnekra.
23:101: Ma ṣuḍen di lbuq, assen, ur ţţemyilin, ur ţmesteqsayen.
23:102: Wid iwumi ẓẓay lmizan nnsen, nitni rebḥen.
23:103: Wid iwumi fessus lmizan nnsen, d nitni i issexsṛen iman nnsen. Di Loahennama ad wekkṛen.
23:104: A ţţesserɣ tmes udmawen nnsen, ad asen zelgen icenfiren.
23:105: Day ur awen qaren ara issekniyen iW, wanag la ten tnekṛem?
23:106: Nnan: "a Mass nneɣ! Iɣleb aneɣ ccum nneɣ. Nella d agdud imɣeṛqen.
23:107: A Mass nneɣ! Ssuffeɣ aneɣ segs. Ma nesnager, ihi, d imednas ay nella".
23:109: Ih, illa urbaɛ n imdanen iW i iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Numen. Semmeḥ aneɣ, Ḥun fellaɣ, Kečč Tifeḍ akw wid iţḥunun".
23:110: Tettihim fellasen armi i wen sseţţun asmekti W, u tdessem degsen.
23:111: Nek, assa, Kufaɣ ten ɣef wayen ṣebṛen. D nitni, war ccekk, ay d imerbaḥ.
23:113: Nnan: "Neqqim ass, neɣ ur ibbwiḍ wass, steqsi wid iḥeţben".
23:114: Inna: "cwiṭ kan ay teqqimen, lemmer, s tideţ, day tessinem".
23:115: Day tɣilem Nxelq ikwen, kan, di rrayaɛ; ar ur d teţţuɣalem ɣuṛneɣ?
23:116: Ay Meqqweṛ Ṛebbi, Agellid, Tideţ! Ur illi ṛebbi, siwa Neţţa, Mass n usgeld ukyis.
23:117: Win inaɛṛen, ar tama n Ṛebbi, ṛebbi nniḍen, ur isɛi ţţbut fellas, aqeṭṭi s ar Mass is kan. Ih, ur rebḥen ara ijehliyen.
23:118: Ini: "a Mass iw! Semmeḥ u Ḥun. Kečč, Tifeḍ akw wid iţḥunun".
24:1: Tasureţ, Nessader iţ id, Nḥeţţem iţ id; Nessader ed, degs, issekniyen iberrzen, amar a d temmektim.
24:2: Tin neɣ win iznan, jekwḍet, yal yiwen segsen, tawinest iberdan; ur kwen ţɣaḍen ɣef udem n Ṛebbi, ma tellam tumnem s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Arbaɛ n lmumnin, ad yili d anagi uɛaqeb nnsen.
24:3: Win iznan ur iţţaɣ siwa tin iznan, neɣ tamcarekt. Tin iznan ur ţ iţţaɣ siwa win iznan, neɣ amcarek. Iţwagdel waya i lmumnin.
24:4: Wid itehmen tiɛaṛḍiyin, dɣa ur d bbwin kuẓ inagan, jekwḍet ţen ṭamet iberdan; ur qeblet ccada nnsen, d awezɣi. Widen d iballaɣen.
24:5: Kkes ed wid isteṛoɛen, deffir waya, u xedmen lfayeq. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
24:6: Wid itehmen tilawin nnsen, ur sɛin inagan, siwa iman nnsen, yiwen segsen ad iggal s Ṛebbi, kuẓ iberdan, ar neţţa d bab n tideţ,
24:7: akked ubrid wis smus ar a t Ixzu Ṛebbi ma iskaddeb.
24:8: Ur teţţuɛaqeb tmeṭṭut, ma teggul s Ṛebbi, kuẓ iberdan, ar neţţa seg wid iskadben,
24:9: akked ubrid, wis smus ar fellas zzɛaf n Ṛebbi, ma issawel ed tideţ.
24:10: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S! Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Issuruf, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
24:11: Ih, wid isweṣlen tikerkas, d agraw segwen. Ur ţɣilit d cceṛṛ i kunwi, xaṭi, d lxiṛ nnwen. Yal yiwen, degsen, ibbwi ayen ibbwi ubekkaḍ. Aɛaqeb abarar i win, segsen, i ibbwin amur ameqwṛaḥan.
24:12: A lemmer lmumnin, argaz tameṭṭut, mi s slan, meyyzen lxiṛ, deg iman nnsen, u nnan: "wagi d tikerkas ibanen"!
24:13: A lemmer d bbwin, fellas, kuẓ inagan! Ma ur d bbwin ara inagan, ar Ṛebbi, wigi, d ikeddaben.
24:14: Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S, di ddunit akked laxeṛt, a ţţesɛaddim aɛaqeb abarar ɣef wayen iɣef temcawaṛem.
24:15: Mi ţ id teggarem s yilsawen nnwen, u teqqaṛen s imawen nnwen ayen ur tessinem, tɣilem d ulac. Neţţa, ar Ṛebbi, d abarar.
24:16: Lemmer, mi as teslam, tennam: "ur aɣ issefk ara umeslay ɣef waya! Gedha s yiseK! Wagi d acehrir abarar".
24:17: Inuba kwen Ṛebbi ur teţţalsem, am akka, d awezɣi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
24:18: Iţbeggin awen Ṛebbi issekniyen. Ṛebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
24:19: Ih, wid ibɣan a d iazel lɛaṛ, ar wid iumnen, fellasen aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Ṛebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
24:20: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S! U Ṛebbi d Umɛin, Iţḥunu.
24:21: A wid iumnen! Ur teddut di lateṛ n Cciṭan. Win iteddun di lateṛ n Cciṭan, ar la iteddu di lɛaṛ akked tuccḍa. Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S, ur iţţizdig degwen yiwen, d awezɣi. Maca, Ṛebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
24:22: Wid, degwen, iwumi iţţunefk lfeḍl akked terkunt, ur ţgalan ɣef tikci i llzem, i imeɣban, i wid iunagen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ad semmḥen, ad ssurfen. Day ur tḥemmlem ara mara awen Isemmeḥ Ṛebbi? Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
24:23: Ih, wid iţqeṛṛiḍen tilawin zeddigen, istehzan, iumnen, ad ţwaxzun di ddunit, di laxeṛt. Fellasen aɛaqeb abarar.
24:24: Ass ideg ara d cehhden ɣef igiten nnsen, ilsawen nnsen, ifassen nnsen, iḍaṛen nnsen,
24:25: assen, ad asen Ifk Ṛebbi ayen ţţalasen, s tideţ. Ad ẓṛen ar Ṛebbi d Tideţ ibanen.
24:26: Yir tlawin i yir irgazen, yir irgazen i yir tlawin. Tilawin n lɛali i irgazen n lɛali, irgazen lɛali i tlawin n lɛali. Wigi ur ţţkan deg wayen qqaṛen. I nitni, ssmaḥ akked ṛṛeẓq ukyis.
24:27: A wid iumnen! Ur kečmet ixxamen ur nelli nnwen, alamma s tsriḥ, u alamma tselmem ɣef imawlan nnsen. Pţif akka i kunwi, amar a d tesmektim.
24:28: Ma ur tufim ḥedd degsen, ur kečmet alamma s tsriḥ. Ma nnan awen d: "uɣalet", uɣalet. Yif it wakka i ṣṣfawa nnwen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
24:29: Ulac uɣilif fellawen ma tkecmem ixxamen ur neţwazdeɣ, ma tella tɣawsa nnwen degsen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa acu d teqqaṛem, u wacu teţţeffrem.
24:30: Ini i wid iumnen ad brun i wallen nnsen, ad ssṛen tuzzuft nnsen. Yif it wakka i ṣṣfawa nnsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa ayen xeddmen.
24:31: Ini i tid iumnen ad brunt i wallen nnsent, ad ssṛent tuzzuft nnsent, ur d sskanent, di zzin nnsent, siwa ayen d iḍehṛen segs, ad ɣumment idmaren nnsent. Ur d sskanent ccbuḥ nnsent, siwa i irgazen nnsent, neɣ ibabaten nnsent, neɣ imɣaṛen nnsent, neɣ iqcicen nnsent, neɣ irbiben nnsent, neɣ atmaten nnsent, neɣ iqcicen n watmaten nnsent, neɣ wid n tsetmatin nnsent, neɣ tiqeddacin nnsent, neɣ taklatin nnsent, neɣ iqeddacen imudduzen, neɣ arrac ur nellemẓi. Ur kkatent dderz, ad iţwassen zzin nnsent uffir. Steṛoɛet akw i Ṛebbi, a lmumnin, amar a ţrebḥem.
24:32: Jewoet i iɛzriyen nnwen, akked wid imaɛnen seg waklan nnwen, akked teklatin nnwen. Ma d imeɣban ay llan, a ten Iṛẓeq Ṛebbi, s lfeḍl iS. Ṛebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
24:33: Wid ur nufa ara ar aɣen, ad ṣebṛen ar ten id Iṛẓeq Ṛebbi, s lfeḍl iS. Wid, seg waklan nnwen, i ibɣan ad asen tarum aserreḥ, arut asen ma teẓṛam ten, d at lxiṛ ay llan. Fket asen seg ayla i wen Ifka Ṛebbi. Ur ţḥeţţimet ɣef teklatin nnwen, tiquḥbit, i rrbeḥ nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ma bɣant tezdeg. Ma tḥeţţmen, Ṛebbi, deffir uḥeţţem nnsent, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
24:34: Niɣ Nessader awen ed issekniyen iberrzen, akked umedya n wid iɛacen uqbel nnwen, d anabi i wid iţḥezziben.
24:35: Ṛebbi d tafat n tmurt akked igenwan. Amedya n tafat iS d takwaţ degs taftilt. Taftilt daxel n tqeṛɛaţ. Taqeṛɛaţ, amzun d itri acṛaṛaq, tecɛal it ttejṛa iṛqan, tazemmurt ur nelli n ugmuḍ neɣ n utaram. Qṛib a ţfet zzit is, ur ţ tennul tmes. Tafat ɣef tafat. Iţţawi Ṛebbi win i S ihwan ar tafat iS. Iţţak ed Ṛebbi imedyaten i medden. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa yal cci.
24:36: Deg ixxamen i Ibɣa Ṛebbi ad ufraren, ideg ara d immekti yisem iS, sbuccuɛen T ssbeḥ, tameddit.
24:37: Irgazen ur tesɣafal ttjaṛa, neɣ ssuq, ɣef usmekti n Ṛebbi, ɣef tẓallit, ɣef zzakat; ţţagwaden ass, ideg ara nehwwalen wallen akked wulawen.
24:38: Iwakken a ten Ikafi Ṛebbi ɣef wayen xeddmen d amxallef, ad asen Irnu si lfeḍl iS. Ṛebbi Iţɣiti win i S ihwan, war aktili.
24:39: Igiten n wid ijehlen, am aylal deg uzaɣaṛ. Win ifuden, ad iɣil d aman. Alamma mi ibbweḍ ɣuṛes, ur iţţaf acemma. A n iaf Ṛebbi, Issuli as leḥsab is. Ṛebbi Iţɣawal deg uqeṭṭi.
24:40: Neɣ am tillas di yill leɣmiq. Tɣumm it lmuja, sufella lmuja, sufella asigna. Tillas sennig tiyaḍ. Ma issuffeɣ ed afus is, ur issaweḍ a t iwali. Win iwumi ur Iga ara Ṛebbi tafat, ur isɛi tafat.
24:41: Day ur twalaḍ ara, sbuccuɛen Ṛebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taẓallit akked usbuccaɛ n yal yiwen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa ayen xeddmen.
24:42: N Ṛebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. ɣuṛ Ṛebbi tuɣalin.
24:43: Ur twalaḍ ara Ṛebbi Isselḥay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issemɣweṛ? Dɣa a ţwaliḍ ageffur a d iffeɣ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iḍeṛṛef ɣef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebṛaq iS qṛib a ţţeglu s yiẓṛi.
24:44: Ṛebbi Ismizwar iḍ akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tideţ, d aselmed i wid isɛan iẓṛi.
24:45: Ṛebbi Ixleq akw lḥayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win iţţeḥnunufen ɣef uɛabbuḍ is, win ileḥḥun ɣef sin iḍaṛṛen, win ileḥḥun ɣef kuẓ. Ixelleq Ṛebbi ayen i S ihwan. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izmer i yal cci.
24:46: Niɣ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Ṛebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
24:47: Qqaṛen: "numen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan, nuɣ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeṛ urbaɛ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.
24:48: Mi ţwanecden ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iḥudd garasen, arbaɛ segsen iwexxeṛ.
24:49: Ma sɛan lḥeqq, a d asen ɣuṛes, d imḍuɛen.
24:50: Day helken wulawen nnsen, neɣ cukken, neɣ ugaden a ten Isneḥyaf Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaṭi, widak d imednas.
24:51: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aḥuddu n Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iḥudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nṛuḍa". D wigi ay d imerbaḥ.
24:52: Win iṛuḍan Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, iţţagwaden Ṛebbi, iţḥezziben, nitni d isaɛdiyen.
24:53: Ggulen s Ṛebbi, tagallit meqqwṛen, ar ma tumṛeḍ asen, ard ad ffɣen, war ccekk. Ini: "ur ţgallat, annuz iţwassen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem".
24:54: Ini: "ṛaḍit Ṛebbi, ṛaḍit Amazan". Ma wexxṛen, fellas, neţţa, ayen kan i s sbabben, fellawen kunwi ayen i wen sbabben. Ma tṛuḍam T, a ţţeţţwanhum. I iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal iţbegginen.
24:55: Iɛahed Ṛebbi, i wid iumnen segwen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ara ten Irr, war ccekk, d igensas di tmurt, akken Irra wid i ten id izwaren; ara ad asen Isseqɛad ddin nnsen iɣef i ten Iṛuḍa; ar ad asen Issegwri laman, deffir tugdi. Ɛabden iyI, ur iyI ţcaraken acemma. Wid ijehlen, deffir waya, widak d iballaɣen.
24:56: Beddet i tẓallit, zekkit, aɣet awal i Umazan. Amar aḥunu fellawen.
24:57: ɣuṛwat a ţɣilem wid ijehlen sfunnugen di tmurt. Axxam nnsen d times. A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
24:58: A wid iumnen! S uɛammed nnwen ara d kecmen, ɣuṛwen, waklan nnwen akw wid, degwen, ur nebliɣ ara, kraḍ iberdan ideg ur telsim ara: uqbel taẓallit n tafrara, ɣef ṭṭhuṛ mara tekksem iceṭṭiḍen, deffir tẓallit n lɛica. Ulac uɣilif fellawen neɣ fellasen, ma wa iẓuṛ wa, deffir lewqat agi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
24:59: Ma belɣen warrac nnwen, s uɛammed nnwen, am wid i ten id izwaren. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen iS. Ṛebbi Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
24:60: Ulac uɣilif ɣef tɛuqaṛ i iɛaddan i jwao, ma kksent iceṭṭiḍen nnsent, mebla ma sseknent ccbuḥ nnsent. Ma setḥant, yif it i nitenti. Ṛebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
24:61: Ur telli tiyta deg uderɣal, neɣ deg urejdal, neɣ deg umuḍin, neɣ degwen, ma teččam deg ixxamen nnwen, deg wid n ibabaten nnwen, deg wid n tyimmatin nnwen, deg wid n watmaten nnwen, deg wid n tsetmatin nnwen, deg wid iɛammiten nnwen, deg wid n tɛammitin nnwen, deg wid ixaliten nnwen, deg wid n txaltitin nnwen, deg wid ideg tesɛam tisura, ar uḥbib nnwen. Ulac uɣilif fellawen ma teččam d agraw, neɣ d ifṛiden. Mara tkecmen ixxamen, msalamet s wazul iṛqan, aḥmayan, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Ṛebbi issekniyen. Amar a ţfehmem.
24:62: Lmumnin, siwa wid iumnen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma llan yides ɣef lameṛ iten icerken, ur ţṛuḥun alamma ssutren as tsriḥ. Ih, wid i k issuturen tsriḥ, d nitni i iumnen s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma ssutren ak tsriḥ, ɣef kra iten iaɛnan, serreḥ i win i k ihwan, segsen. Ssuter i Ṛebbi ad sen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
24:63: Ur ḥeţbet asiwwel garawen i Umazan, am mara temsawalem. Ih, Iẓṛa Ṛebbi wid, segwen, iţţensaren s tuffra. Ad steḥdren wid mgirrden lameṛ iS: ad ţţuhewwlen, neɣ ad sɛaddin aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
24:64: Ih, day mačči n Ṛebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Niɣ Iẓṛa amek tellam ɣuṛeS. Ass n tuɣalin nnsen ɣuṛeS, ad asen Imel d acu xedmen. Ṛebbi Issen yal cci.
25:1: Ad Iṛqu Win id Issadren afraz, i umdan iS, iwakken ad yili d aneddaṛ imaḍalen.
25:2: Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan; ur Isɛi mmi S; ur aS illi ucrik di tgelda. Ixleq yal cci, Iwezn it s lmizan.
25:3: Ddmen, war Neţţa, iṛebbiten ur nexliq acemma. D nitni i iţwaxelqen. Ur ţseyyin ḍḍeṛ neɣ abaɣuṛ, i iman nnsen. Ur ţseyyin di tmeţţant neɣ di tmeddurt, neɣ di tnekra.
25:4: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ayagi, d tikerkas kan. Isnulfa tent id, iɛawen it, fellas, ugdud nniḍen. Niɣ densen u skaddben".
25:5: Nnan: "d timucuha imezwura, i iura; qqaṛen as tent ṣṣbeḥ, tameddit".
25:6: Ini: "Issader it id, Win Issnen sser n tmurt akked igenwan. Neţţa, s tideţ, Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu".
25:7: Nnan: "d acut Umazan agi i iteţţen lqut, iteddun ar leswaq? A lemmer id irs ɣuṛes lmelk, ara yilin yides d aneddaṛ,
25:8: neɣ iţţunefk as ugerruj, neɣ isɛa aqwiṛ iteţţ segs"! Nnan imednas: "la teţţeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseḥren".
25:9: Wali amek id ţţaken fellak imedyaten. Nnetlafen, ur zmiren ad ţwanhun.
25:10: Ad Iṛqu Win ad ak Ifken, ma Irad, i ifen ayagi: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen. Ad ak Issali lebṛuo.
25:11: Xaṭi, nekṛen imir. Nhegga d times i win inekṛen imir.
25:12: Mi ten twala si tama ibaɛden, ad as slen s leḥṛaṛa akked zzhir.
25:13: Mara ɣlin degs, nitni ţwarzen deg umekkan uqmiḍ, ad siwlen, dinna, i wangar.
25:14: "Ur ssawalet ara, assa, i yiwet n wangar, ssiwlet i waṭas n wangaren".
25:15: Ini: "ţţif ayagi, neɣ Loennet n lebda i Nɛahed i wid iţḥezziben? D neţţat ay d arraz, ay d taggara, i nitni".
25:16: I nitni degs, ayen i sen ihwan, i lebda. D lemɛahda iɣef Iuksan Mass ik.
25:17: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, nitni akked wid ɛabden, war Ṛebbi, ad Yini: "d kunwi i itelfen imdanen iW agi, neɣ d nitni i iffɣen abrid"?
25:18: A d inin: "gedha s yiseK! Ur aɣ issefk a neddu d bab, war Kečč. Maca, Tɣateḍ ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ţţun asmekti, uɣalen d agdud ixeṣṛen".
25:19: Atan nekṛen kwen ɣef wayen d tennam. Ihi ur tezmirem i tsensert, neɣ i leslak. Win idensen, degwen, a Nessukk fellas, aɛaqeb ameqwṛan.
25:20: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, imazanen, mebla ma llan teţţen lqut, u teddun ar leswaq. Nerra kwen, wa ihewwel wa, ma a ţṣebṛem. Mass ik Izga la d Ismuqul.
